screens.name: Camera Scanner
features: Full screen viewport simulating device camera.
Dark overlay mask (camera_overlay) with a clear central rectangle for document framing.
Bottom control bar with 'capture_shutter' button centered.
Bottom left thumbnail gallery showing count of already scanned pages.

screens.name: Scan Review & OCR
features: Displays cropped image of document at the top (max-h-[30vh]).
Confidence score badge prominently displayed below image (Grön > 90%, Gul 70-90%, Röd < 70%).
Structured text output area with Headings parsed as Cabinet Grotesk (font-heading).
'Scanna om' (Rescan) button visible, highlighted particularly if confidence is yellow/red.
Bottom action bar with 'Lägg till sida' (Add page) and 'Fortsätt' (Continue) buttons.

screens.name: Email Composer & Send
features: Scrollable text area containing combined structured OCR text from all scanned pages.
Recipients Section: 2x2 Grid of 4 Fixed Recipient Buttons (Emil, Louise, Anton, William).
Recipient buttons should act as radio/toggles for selecting who to send to.
Sticky bottom 'Skicka' (Send) primary action button via Commhub.

app_logo.description: Minimalist b/w app icon for empty states or splash screen. Use in Header or Loading states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile web app simulating iOS native behavior (React Native Expo style translated to web using Tailwind).
No login required. The app should open directly to the Camera view.
Implement the Swedish localization terms strictly.
The UI must feel like a native iOS app. Ensure all interactive elements have active scale transitions (`active:scale-[0.98]`).
Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) for UI icons and recipient avatars if no photo is available (e.g., User icons).
Parse OCR output dynamically to ensure headers are explicitly bolded using the `Cabinet Grotesk` font.
Enforce APCA contrast ratios on all text over backgrounds.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements as defined in the testing section.
